image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a blue sky. The central element is a weathered, cylindrical post with a complex, somewhat distorted mounting bracket at the top. Two blue rectangular signs extend from the post. The text on the signs appears to be gibberish or alien-like script rather than legible English or standard characters. There are green leaves visible in the bottom right corner.
